UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user's private profile, device readiness summary, and primary trusted contact configuration.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

email.description: Normalized lowercase email address of the user.

displayName.description: Display name of the user shown in alerts.

trustedContactName.description: Name of the user's primary trusted contact.

trustedContactEmail.description: Email address of the primary trusted contact.

trustedContactPhone.description: Phone number of the primary trusted contact.

trustedContactRelationship.description: Optional relationship label (e.g. Family, Partner, Friend).

trustedContactVerificationStatus.description: Current verification and readiness state of the trusted contact.

shareLocation.description: Whether GPS coordinates and Google Maps links are shared in alerts.

popUpAlertsEnabled.description: Whether high-priority phone pop-up alerts are enabled.

fcmDeviceCount.description: Number of active FCM devices registered by this user.

notificationsEnabled.description: Whether Android emergency notifications are enabled on this user's registered device.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

RecipientDeviceRegistration.title: RecipientDeviceRegistration
RecipientDeviceRegistration.description: Private FCM device token registration associated with an authenticated user account. Supports multiple devices per user and is never exposed to other users.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the device owner.

fcmToken.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging registration token for push delivery.

notificationsEnabled.description: True only when Android POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission and emergency channel are enabled.

sdkInt.description: Android API level of the device.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the device registration was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the token or permission status was last refreshed.

TrustedContactLink.title: TrustedContactLink
TrustedContactLink.description: Privacy-preserving trusted contact invitation, authorization request, and recipient readiness verification record between a sender and a trusted contact.

linkId.description: Deterministic or unique identifier of the trusted-contact link.

senderUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the sender requesting or inviting the contact.

senderEmail.description: Normalized lowercase email address of the sender.

recipientEmail.description: Normalized lowercase email address of the trusted contact.

recipientPhone.description: Optional phone number of the trusted contact.

relationship.description: Relationship label (e.g. Family, Partner, Friend, Caregiver).

recipientUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the recipient once verified or accepted.

status.description: Truthful verification and alert readiness status of the trusted contact.

statusDetail.description: Human-readable explanation of the contact's registration, acceptance, and device notification status.

recipientHasRegisteredAccount.description: True when the recipient has a verified SoloSignal account.

recipientAccepted.description: True when the recipient has explicitly accepted the trusted-contact request.

recipientRegisteredDeviceCount.description: Number of FCM-registered devices on the recipient's account (does not expose device tokens).

recipientNotificationsEnabled.description: True when at least one registered recipient device has Android notification permission enabled.

shareLocation.description: Whether the sender shares GPS location with this contact during emergencies.

popUpAlertsEnabled.description: Whether high-priority pop-up alerts are enabled for this contact.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the link was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the link was last updated.

EmergencyAlert.title: EmergencyAlert
EmergencyAlert.description: Real-time possible-fall or test alert dispatched from a sender to an authorized trusted contact with FCM push delivery, email delivery tracking, and recipient phone pop-up support.

senderUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the sender who triggered the alert.

recipientName.description: Display name of the trusted contact recipient.

recipientEmail.description: Normalized lowercase email address of the trusted contact recipient.

recipientPhone.description: Optional phone number of the recipient.

recipientUid.description: Optional Firebase Auth UID of the recipient once verified or delivered.

linkId.description: Optional TrustedContactLink ID authorizing this alert.

isTestAlert.description: True if this is an explicit non-emergency test alert.

subjectLine.description: Alert headline or email subject line.

bodyText.description: Full formatted alert message body including timestamp and location.

triggerReason.description: Why the alert was triggered (countdown expired, manual help button, or test).

deliveryStatusDetail.description: Human-readable explanation of the current delivery status or error.

providerMessageId.description: Actual FCM/email/messaging provider message ID or Firestore delivery receipt ID.

fcmDeliveryStatus.description: Status of FCM push notification dispatch to recipient devices.

fcmDeliveredCount.description: Number of recipient devices that received the FCM push notification.

emailDeliveryStatus.description: Status of the transactional email dispatch to recipientEmail.

emailProvider.description: Name of the Google email delivery service used.

emailProviderMessageId.description: Verified message ID returned by the email provider.

emailError.description: Exact error returned if email delivery failed.

channelUsed.description: Delivery channel used (e.g. EMAIL, SOLOSIGNAL_POPUP, GOOGLE_CHAT).

escalationStatus.description: Server-side 15-second acknowledgement timeout and Google Meet video-call fallback state.

escalationDeadlineMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when the 15-second acknowledgement window expires.

meetUrl.description: Google Meet meeting URI created when the trusted contact does not acknowledge within 15 seconds.

meetSpaceName.description: Google Meet API space resource name (e.g. spaces/xxxx).

meetError.description: Exact error message if Google Meet space creation failed.

googleMapsUrl.description: Optional clickable Google Maps URL for the sender's location.

locationSummary.description: Formatted location coordinates or reason location was unavailable.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the alert was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the alert was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user private profile and trusted contact settings.

/users/{userId}/devices/{deviceId}.description: Private FCM device token registrations for the authenticated user.

/trusted_contact_links/{linkId}.description: Privacy-preserving trusted contact invitations, authorization requests, and recipient readiness state.

/emergency_alerts/{alertId}.description: End-to-end emergency and test alerts with FCM push status, email provider status, and recipient pop-up notification triggers.
